thread:
sam: Heads-up — AcmeCorp seeing intermittent 422 "Invalid JSON" from our API when using response_format=structured_json & mode=strict. They say it works then fails. Request IDs: req_1a2b3c, req_1a2b3d

support-bot: Created ticket #SUP-4821 and attached logs.

julia (prod-sre): Can you paste the exact curl they used?

sam: Sure, here's the repro curl (from customer):
```curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json; profile=structured" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize: ..."}'
```

sam: They also sometimes send Accept first and Content-Type second. When they reorder headers failures spike.

liam-ml: Noted. We had a gateway bug where Accept header parsing fell back to first header token when multiple headers present — could cause content-negotiation mismatch with response_format. I'll check.

anita (support): Customer also rotated API key during tests; one failing req had 401 then our client retried with new key — maybe intermediate 401 produced HTML error page that our JSON strict mode didn't accept.

liam-ml: Reproduced locally by sending Accept: text/html,application/json and response_format=structured — gateway returned 200 HTML for some combos.

julia (prod-sre): Can we get request_id + raw response for a failing call? Sam, can you ask customer to capture curl --trace-ascii and paste here or share a HAR?

sam: Sent repro HAR to ticket. Attached observation: when Accept header contains both types and the order is html first, our upstream (nginx) returns HTML error page on auth failure — strict mode then 422.

liam-ml: Patch proposed: normalize Accept header to prefer any 'profile=structured' token irrespective of ordering, and on 401/403 do not serve HTML body in strict JSON responses — return structured error JSON with appropriate content-type.

julia (prod-sre): Sounds good. Priority P1 for Dedicated/enterprise customers. Can eng-runtime triage? @eng-runtime

eng-runtime: ACK. Will deploy 2 fixes: header normalization + structured error on auth fallback. Rolling deploy to staging in 30m.

sam: Customer updated — will test tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 

anita (support): Note for docs: add note about header ordering and retry behavior.
